I contacted both the merchant and Paddle.net multiple times before the trial was even complete to cancel, yet the charges continued. Paddle.net’s name appears on my bank statement, but they refuse to take responsibility or help me reach the merchant. The app itself provided no clear way to cancel, and my repeated messages through their “Contact Me” section have gone unanswered.

This has been a nightmare to resolve. I was forced to stop paying my credit card just to block these charges from processing. I even tried reporting them as fraudulent to my bank because neither Paddle.net nor the merchant would respond. They FINALLY cancelled after 3 unsuccessful charges. 

At this point, I don’t ever want to see “Paddle.net” or “PhotoApp” on my bank statement again. Please refund the last two charges immediately. It should never be this difficult to cancel a service, and the lack of accountability here is unacceptable.
